projectState.summary: Byte 13a is implemented on `codex/byte-13a` and awaiting review. It adds `docs/persistence-records.md` as a docs-only persistence prep companion to `docs/persistence-checkpoints.md`, defining durable record families for sessions, musical events, player thought request/response/acceptance, slow-thought playback windows, song sketches, deterministic proposals, model proposal text, checkpoints, and moments. It separates replay payloads from seek-and-continue generator state, records the future grid-vs-performed pitch gap, and banks the rule that model prose is data rather than executable instruction. No SQLite files, persistence writes, runtime behavior, playback, transport, or scheduling changes were added.
